name: neon-flicker-sign
title: Neon Flicker Sign
description: A neon sign built from text-shadow stacks with a scripted flicker that buzzes specific letters off-beat — the failure pattern of real signage, applied per glyph, resting steady most of the time.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Per Glyph Script: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
